REL=Path('/app/release') def token_hash(v): return hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest() def record(scope): return next(x for x in json.loads(REL.joinpath('registry.json').read_text())['authorizations'] if x['scope']==scope) class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def auth(self,scope): r=record(scope); h=self.headers.get('Authorization','') return r['active'] and h.startswith('Bearer ') and token_hash(h[7:])==r['token_sha256'] def do_POST(self): if not self.path.startswith('/publish/') or not self.auth('publish:vectorops:0.1.0'): self.send_response(401); self.end_headers(); return name=os.path.basename(self.path); allowed=name.startswith('vectorops-0.1.0') if not allowed: self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return body=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))); ROOT.joinpath('packages',name).write_bytes(body) if name.endswith('.whl'): ROOT.joinpath('simple/vectorops/index.html').write_text(''+html.escape(name)+'\n') self.send_response(201); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b'accepted') def do_GET(self): if self.path=='/admin/health': if not self.auth('admin:health:read'): self.send_response(401); self.end_headers(); return self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b'repository-ready'); return if self.path=='/admin/authorize': if not self.auth('publish:vectorops:0.1.0'): self.send_response(401); self.end_headers(); return r=record('publish:vectorops:0.1.0'); self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(('authorization '+r['id']+' scope='+r['scope']+' decision=allow').encode()); return p=ROOT/self.path.lstrip('/') if p.is_dir(): p=p/'index.html' if not p.is_file(): self.send_response(404); self.end_headers(); return self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Type','text/html' if p.suffix=='.html' else 'application/octet-stream'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(p.read_bytes()) def log_message(self,*args): pass HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',8080),H).serve_forever() ''' p.joinpath('repository_server.py').write_text(server) PY chmod 600 /app/release/publisher.token /app/release/health.token /app/release/registry.json /app/release/repository_server.py; {"command": "set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,urllib.request
p=Path('/app/release'); wheel=next(Path('/app/dist').glob('vectorops-0.1.0-*.whl'))
def request(path,token,data=None):
    req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8080'+path,data=data,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token},method='POST' if data is not None else 'GET')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as r: return r.status,r.read()
health=p.joinpath('health.token').read_text().strip(); publisher=p.joinpath('publisher.token').read_text().strip()
hc,hb=request('/admin/health',health); assert hc==200
wc,_=request('/publish/'+wheel.name,publisher,wheel.read_bytes()); assert wc==201
manifest={'name':'vectorops','version':'0.1.0','wheel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'signature_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.joinpath('vectorops-0.1.0.sig').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
p.joinpath('release-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest)+'\n')
mc,_=request('/publish/vectorops-0.1.0.release.json',publisher,p.joinpath('release-manifest.json').read_bytes()); assert mc==201
print(f'health_http={hc} body={hb.decode()}')
print(f'publish_codes wheel={wc} manifest={mc}')
state=json.loads(p.joinpath('registry.json').read_text())
for r in state['authorizations']:
    if r['id']=='repository-health-reader': r['active']=False
p.joinpath('registry.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n'); p.joinpath('health.token').unlink()
print('authorization_record repository-health-reader admin:health:read active=False')
PY"}

messages.content: I will query the publication authorization used for this release.

function.arguments:
{"command": "set -e; token=$(cat /app/release/publisher.token); python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
token=Path('/app/release/publisher.token').read_text().strip()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/authorize',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as r:
    print('authorization_http='+str(r.status))
    print(r.read().decode())
PY"}
function.name: bash
